items.summary: AlloyDB for PostgreSQLFeatureDirect Iceberg access in AlloyDB for PostgreSQL is available for PostgreSQL 18and later (in Preview).This feature lets you query Apache Iceberg tables in Cloud Storage or Lakehouseruntime catalog and accelerate analytical queries using the AlloyDB columnarengine.For more information, seeAccess Iceberg data fromAlloyDB.FeatureSyncing data from BigQuery into AlloyDB is generally available(GA). This featurelets you copy or mirror analytical tables from BigQuery into AlloyDB forlow-latency operational access using the alloydb_sync extension.For more information, seeSync BigQuery data to AlloyDB.FeatureAlloyDB Express is available inPreview forPostgreSQL 18. Optimized for rapid prototyping and for workflows that use AIcoding agents, this configuration provides the following features:Fast provisioningScale-to-zero compute when idleA monthly free tier for the first 12 months of usageOne-click upgrades to AlloyDB for PostgreSQLFor more information, seeAlloyDB Express overview.Apigee Operator for kubernetesAnnouncementOn November 4, 2026, we released an updated version of Apigee.FeatureThe Apigee Operator for Kubernetes version 1.1.2 is now available.SecurityBug IDDescription521387476, 521388685, 521389473, 521389648, 521390401, 521390431, 521418315, 521467563, 521470029, 521523106, 521532318, 522502328, 522502515, 522502723, 522508097, 522515015, 522515987, 523406508, 524990439, 525000385, 525013469, 545525835, 545535262, 545546643, 545547894, 545594793, 545595426, 545604082, 545605504, 545613200, 545619209, 546865118, 549708263, 572097689, 572100132Security fixes for Netty in the Apigee Operator for Kubernetes.
